lines.text: پیش از احتراق بچند روز در مغرب مخفی شوند و بعد از ان بچند روز در مشرق ظاهر شوند
lines.en: Before combustion, they are hidden in the west for a few days, and after that, they appear in the east for a few days.

lines.text: سبب آن بود که چون شمس از مقابله کوکب علوي منصرف شود هر اینه بواسطه سرعت طلوع
lines.en: The reason for this is that when the Sun turns away from the opposition of a superior planet, inevitably, due to the speed of rising,

lines.text: بر کوکب سبقت گیرد و روز بروز متقارب با و شود تا بحد بینهما شصت درجه آید و کوکب را
lines.en: it overtakes the planet and day by day gets closer to it until the distance between them reaches sixty degrees, and the planet

lines.text: در اینحال مغربي خوانند بسبب انکه شبانگاه نزدیک بافق مغرب مرئي شود و هر چند بر اید
lines.en: in this state is called western, because at nightfall it becomes visible near the western horizon, and however much it rises,

lines.text: نزدیکتر شود تا در حوالي افق در تحت شعاع مخفي شود و در اینحال او را مغموره و تحت
lines.en: it gets closer until it is hidden under the rays in the vicinity of the horizon, and in this state it is called immersed and under

lines.text: الشعاع خوانند تا محترق شود و بعد از احتراق چون افتاب بسرعت از او بگذرد
lines.en: the rays until it is combusted. And after combustion, when the Sun quickly passes it

lines.text: او در طلوع سبقت گیرد بر افتاب اما از غلبه نور خورشید هنوز مرئي نشود تا چون بمقدار
lines.en: it overtakes the Sun in rising, but due to the dominance of the Sun's light, it is not yet visible until, when by the amount of

lines.text: از یکدیگر دور شوند کوکب صباح در مشرق بنظر در اید و آن ظهور او بود بعد از ان او را
lines.en: they move away from each other, the planet appears in the east in the morning, and that is its appearance. After that, it is called

lines.text: مشرقي خوانند و اگر بعد او میان او و افتاب شصت درجه شود و چون از ان بگذرد و نه
lines.en: eastern, and if its distance between it and the Sun becomes sixty degrees, and when it passes that and not

lines.text: مشرقي بود و نه مغربي تا که بعد از مقابله باز بحد تقریب رسد که شصت درجه است و بحالت
lines.en: it is eastern and not western until after opposition it again reaches the limit of proximity, which is sixty degrees, and to the state

lines.text: اوّل عود کند و بعضي حد تشریق و تغریب را در علویه نود درجه دانند و احتراق ایشان
lines.en: it returns to the first state. And some consider the limit of eastern and western appearance in superior planets to be ninety degrees, and their combustion

lines.text: يعني کواکب علویه در اواسط ایام استقامت باشد بیانش انست که قادر لم یزل بتقدیر
lines.en: meaning the superior planets is in the middle of the days of station, its explanation is that the Eternal Omnipotent by the decree

lines.text: ازلي چنان ساخته است که دایما بعد کواکب علویه را از ذروه تدویر ایشان نسبت باجزاء
lines.en: of eternity, has made it such that always the distance of the superior planets from the apogee of their epicycle relative to the parts

lines.text: تدویر بقدر بعد مرکز تدویر است از افتاب نسبت باجزاي فلک البروج و چون چنین
lines.en: of the epicycle is equal to the distance of the center of the epicycle from the Sun relative to the parts of the zodiac. And since it is so,

lines.text: بود دایما کوکب علویرا احتراق در ذروه تدویر بود که وسط ایام استقامتست
lines.en: always the combustion of a superior planet is at the apogee of the epicycle, which is the middle of the days of station,

lines.text: و مقابله با افتاب در حضیض که وسط ایام رجعتست و این هر دو تقريبي است و لهذا
lines.en: and opposition with the Sun is at the perigee, which is the middle of the days of retrogradation. And both of these are approximate, and therefore

lines.text: مصنف اواسط گفته است و ربط علویه بافتاب که در باب ششم وعده شده بود اینست
lines.en: the author has said 'middles'. And the connection of the superior planets with the Sun, which was promised in the sixth chapter, is this.

lines.text: و هر یک سفلیین تقریبا در اوسط زمان استقامت که در وقت وصول ایشانست
lines.en: And each of the two inferior planets, approximately in the middle of the time of station, which is at the time of their arrival

lines.text: بذروه تدویر اواسط زمان رجعت تقریبا که وقت وصول ایشانست بحضیض تدویر
lines.en: at the apogee of the epicycle, the middle of the time of retrogradation approximately, which is the time of their arrival at the perigee of the epicycle,

lines.text: محترق شوند
lines.en: they are combusted.

summary.headline: Planetary Combustion and Visibility
summary.text: Explanation of planetary combustion and visibility: superior planets become western, immersed, under the rays, combusted, and then eastern as their angular distance from the Sun changes. It relates combustion and solar opposition to the apogee and perigee of the epicycle, and states that both inferior planets are combusted near the middle of station and retrogradation.
